ITEM 1 | Two wedge-shaped slices of flatbread-style crust with golden-brown to dark-brown blistered, charred edges and a pale tan interior, sitting on a white square plate, footprint roughly 35-40% of the plate, about 1.5 cm thick at the crust rim, with a soft-yet-firm bready texture | 190
ITEM 2 | Melted white cheese layer, pale ivory with small brown toasted spots and bubbly, slightly glossy sheen, covering most of the upper surface of the two slices, partially stringy and soft, about 0.3 cm thick | 60
ITEM 3 | Red tomato-based sauce, deep orange-red, visible in patches between and under the cheese, moist and slightly glossy, spread thinly across the crust, about 0.2 cm thick | 25
